evidence: Application build completed after Sprint 2 UI and pipeline changes.
TypeScript accepted source-file pipeline, assessment screens, and goal builder integration.
Source-file pipeline validates UploadedSourceFile, ExtractedSourceDraft, SourceExtractionReview, and StructuredResponse.
Uploaded file content is not exposed as raw EvidenceRecord.
Official assessment upload creates reviewed source-file pipeline.
Additional source upload creates reviewed source-file pipeline.
Goal builder exposes reviewed uploaded files as a selectable source.
UploadedSourceFile -> ExtractedSourceDraft -> SourceExtractionReview -> StructuredResponse path is represented in code.
Goal screen loads reviewed source-file pipelines instead of reading raw files directly.

completedItems: Added local source-file pipeline using Sprint 1 data contracts.
Connected official assessment uploaded result files to reviewed structured source records.
Connected additional uploaded information sources to reviewed structured source records.
Exposed reviewed uploaded files as goal-builder source context.
Displayed reviewed uploaded-file support inside goal preparation.
incompleteItems: Actual PDF/DOCX/XLSX text extraction is not implemented in this sprint.
Server-side persistence and production file storage are not implemented in this sprint.
Higher-authority plan approval UI remains for a later sprint.
knownGaps: Sprint 2 uses browser-local storage and human-entry review scaffolding.
Structured responses are generated from review statements, not full document parsing.
End-to-end browser automation is not yet added.
